about.title: About MedImpact Global
about.whoText: A creative company built on the belief that stories change things. MedImpact Global Company is a production and media organisation focused on high-quality, purpose-driven content — combining professional expertise, creativity and authentic storytelling. We're drawn to real-life experience, professional challenge, human resilience, healthcare, leadership, community and African perspective.
about.visionText: To become a globally recognised African creative and media company known for exceptional storytelling, professional productions and meaningful social impact.
about.missionText: To create compelling, professionally produced content that educates, entertains, inspires and connects African stories with audiences around the world.

flagship.status: Now in development: The Cardiothoracic Surgeon
flagship.name: The Cardiothoracic Surgeon
flagship.synopsis: Set within a tertiary referral healthcare environment in Kenya, this medical drama follows the professional and personal lives of surgical teams as they confront complex cases, emergencies, ethical decisions and institutional pressure — showcasing teamwork, leadership and the human side of medicine to audiences locally and internationally.
